title: Capture and selectively regenerate annotated walkthrough screenshots

fields.outcome: A documentation producer or CI job can capture ready-to-publish screenshots for every walkthrough step and refresh only the modules affected by a product change.
fields.scope: Integrate screenshot generation into captureJourney, using annotated target screenshots when a step has a role/name target and clean state screenshots for untargeted steps. Store deterministic module/step PNG paths in the walkthrough manifest, support redaction and viewport configuration, expose generated paths in capture results, and extend transactional selective regeneration to screenshot walkthroughs. Exclude presentation frames and backgrounds, cursor animation, DOM asset harvesting, video composition, Markdown synchronization changes, and hosted publishing.
fields.acceptance: Given an executable journey and screenshot capture enabled, every completed step produces one deterministic PNG in module and step order, targetable steps contain the configured annotation, the schema-valid manifest lists those files, secrets and configured sensitive content are redacted, and an invalidation plan replaces only affected module screenshots while preserving reusable module files byte-for-byte.
fields.decisions: Use modules/<module-id>/screenshots/<step-id>.png relative to the capture output. Capture role/name instruction targets immediately before the action so navigation cannot remove them, but publish the frame only after the action succeeds; capture untargeted state steps after the action. Reuse annotateStep for role/name targets and capture an unannotated state image for navigation, scrolling, waits, exact-text targets, and assertions that cannot use the role/name annotation contract. Keep screenshot capture explicit through recordScreenshots so existing injected page doubles remain lightweight, while retaining the current screenshots output type for non-DOM/non-video captures.
fields.verification: Add unit and browser-backed tests for ordered deterministic paths, annotated and clean screenshots, manifest validity, configured redaction, safe failure behavior, and selective screenshot regeneration. Run the full Node test suite, package metadata checks, npm pack dry-run, and frozen AgentHouse evaluation.
fields.dependencies: Builds on ST-03 annotation rendering, ST-07 dependency invalidation, ST-08 transactional regeneration, and ST-09 Markdown screenshot synchronization.
fields.risks: Capturing at the wrong instant can document transient UI, overlays can leak into later screenshots, sensitive content can enter images, and partial regeneration can mix incompatible assets. Capture target instructions before their action and state frames afterward, commit prepared target frames only when the action succeeds, always clean overlays and temporary redaction, and retain the existing staged atomic replacement model.
fields.audience: Developers, support teams, product managers, and marketers generating repository-owned product documentation.
fields.changes: Implemented in commit 3c23fb16ab885db28b686ce1070a370de154e025: captureJourney now generates deterministic clean or annotated PNGs per step, temporarily redacts configured content and credential values without disrupting later actions, records ordered screenshot assets and absolute result paths, and supports transactional selective screenshot regeneration. Documentation, the portable agent skill, navigation-race handling, and focused browser regression coverage were updated with the workflow.
fields.evidence: Frozen AgentHouse evaluation for build 3c23fb16ab885db28b686ce1070a370de154e025 satisfied all six configured checks. The full suite passed 79 tests, including browser-backed screenshot capture, redaction restoration through login, schema-valid ordered assets, failure diagnostics, and profile-only regeneration preserving sign-in screenshots byte-for-byte. Package metadata and ST-08/ST-09 regression profiles passed. A generated 960x540 save-profile frame was visually inspected for target highlight, callout placement, caption readability, and stable framing.
fields.releasePlan: Include annotated screenshot capture and selective screenshot regeneration in the next private 0.1.x pre-release from protected develop after GitHub CI passes. Validate the packed npm artifact before any registry publication; this work item does not authorize npm publication.
fields.rollbackPlan: If screenshot capture disrupts journeys, exposes unredacted content, or regenerates reusable modules, revert commit 3c23fb16ab885db28b686ce1070a370de154e025. Existing DOM and video capture remain independently selectable, and transactional regeneration preserves the previous output on failure.

criteria.expectation: Each completed journey step produces exactly one PNG at modules/<module-id>/screenshots/<step-id>.png in journey order.
Steps with a role/name target render their configured highlight, numbered callout, and caption; untargeted steps render a clean state screenshot.
The schema-valid walkthrough lists each module's screenshot paths in step order and capture results expose the corresponding absolute paths.
Callers can configure a stable viewport and redaction selectors or texts without exposing secrets in returned or JSON artifacts.
A screenshot or annotation failure identifies the module and step through the safe capture error contract and does not produce a successful manifest.
Screenshot regeneration executes prerequisite modules as needed, replaces affected module screenshots, and preserves reusable module screenshots byte-for-byte.
The public capture and regeneration APIs return deterministic machine-readable screenshot results suitable for local and CI workflows.
